channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Odisha Vigilance Recovers ₹75 Lakh Cash and Multi-Crore Assets from Barang Additional Tahsildar
item.description: Odisha Vigilance teams unearthed over ₹75 lakh in cash and multi-crore properties from a Cuttack official.

item.title: Thrown from Moving Van After Gangrape: 25-Year-Old’s Brave Call Saves Her in Faridabad
item.description: 25-year-old gangraped, thrown from van on Gurgaon-Faridabad road; police detain 2 suspects.

item.title: ‘No Flesh Left On Her Body’: Father Dies, Disabled Daughter Found Starving After Alleged Five Years of Abuse by Caretakers in UP
item.description: UP Horror: A servant couple in Mahoba allegedly turned a retired man’s home into a death chamber, resulting in his death.

item.title: CBSE Reschedules March 3 Board Exams for Class 10 and 12, Assures No Change to Remaining Timetable
item.description: CBSE has postponed one Class 10 and one Class 12 board exam scheduled for March 3, 2026, citing administrative reasons while confirming that all other exams will proceed as planned.

item.title: Notebook in One Hand, Christmas Baubles in the Other: Girl’s Grit on Bengaluru Streets Stuns Nation
item.description: A young girl's determination to study while vending Christmas decorations on a bustling street highlights urban India's child labour struggles and festive hardships.

item.title: BJP Councillor Ashok Singh Arrested by Baghelan, Rampur Police for Allegedly Threatening Woman with Death and Molestation
item.description: The arrest of BJP councillor Ashok Singh over alleged threats has raised concerns about misuse of power and the rule of law in local governance.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Tightens New Year Security With Firecracker Ban and Closure of All State Flyovers
item.description: Tamil Nadu has deployed 90,000 police personnel and shut all flyovers to ensure a safe New Year.

item.title: In a Proactive Safety Move, Chandigarh Police Launch Free 112 Pick-and-Drop Service for Women Ahead of New Year’s Eve 2025
item.description: SSP Kanwardeep Kaur announces a dedicated 112 women’s pick-and-drop service alongside 1,100 personnel to secure safe New Year celebrations in Chandigarh.

item.title: MeitY’s Tech Mandate: 50 Lakh+ Platforms Must Auto-Remove Obscene Content or Face Prosecution Amid 25 OTT Blocks
item.description: MeitY's Dec 29 advisory: Platforms over 50 lakh users must AI-remove obscene content amid screening gaps, SC push.

item.title: Bangladesh Leader Osman Hadi Murder: Prime Accused Faisal Karim Masud Denies Role from Dubai, Blames Jamaat-Shibir
item.description: A Dubai video denial, disputed India escape claims, and political rivalries complicate the probe into Osman Hadi’s killing.
